placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for formal asynchronous interface contracts and execution guarantees.
placements.title: Asynchronous Execution Contracts and Guarantees
placements.frame: How do system contracts decouple invocation dispatch from result observation and delivery to prevent blocking and state loss?

placements.why: Ratifies the operational pattern where remember returns an immediate receipt and allows callers to poll cursors or receive piggybacked reactions without losing work if receipts are dropped.
placements.title: Immediate Nonblocking Receipts Decouple Extraction From Delivery
placements.frame: How does immediate receipt issuance with decoupled polling or reaction piggybacking ensure durable extraction without blocking callers?
